requiredFindings.title: Enforce the examined-universe subject-count echo before publication
requiredFindings.detail: Rust3Receiver discards analysisDomain.subjects.len() and entry_echoes checks only examinedUniverse.subjectScopeCommitment. Because ExaminedUniverseV1 permits any uint64 subjectCount, a worker can change that count, recompute the received-entry coverageCommitment, and publish a CoverageV3; the same gap affects terminal Unavailable and BudgetExhausted coverage. Retain the expected base-stage subject count and compare every normal and terminal coverage entry before accounting, P3T, or publication. Add well-shaped wrong-count controls with recomputed commitments for normal and terminal coverage plus a compiled runtime mutation that removes the comparison.
